spans.s: + आरोपण वृक्ष- + आरोपण, n. planting trees.

+ छाय वृक्ष- + छाय,
 I. f. या, the shadow of a single tree.
 II. n. the shade of many trees.
+ तल वृक्ष- + तल, n. the foot of a tree.
+ दंश वृक- + दंश, m. a dog.
+ धूप वृक- + धूप, and वृक्ष-, m. 1. compounded perfume. 2. turpentine.
+ भेदिन् वृक्ष- + भेदिन्, m. 1. a carpenter's chisel. 2. a hatchet.
+ वाटिका वृक्ष- + वाटिका, f. an orchard, Śāk. 8, 21.
† वृक् वृक्, i. 1. Ātm. To take.

वृक, perhaps akin to व्रश्च्,
 I. m.
 1. A wolf, Pañc. 19, 13.
 2. A crow.
 3. A jackal.
 4.

Turpentine.
 5

. Compounded perfume.
 6. A tree. Sesbana grandiflora.
 II. f. का, A plant, Cissampelos hexandra.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Goth. vulfs; A.S. wulf; λύκος; Lat. lupus.
वृकोदर, i. e. वृक-उदर, m. A name of Bhīma, Johns.
वृक्कक, m. The kidney, Yājñ. 3, 94.

† वृक्ष् वृक्ष्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To select.
 2. To cover.
 3. To keep off.
वृक्ष, probably akin to वृह्, [] m. A tree,

; Pañc. iii. d. 107.
 --Comp.

वृक्ष + क, m.
 1. A tree.
 2. A particular tree, Wrightea antidysenterica.
 --Comp.
वृक्ष-भिद्, f. An axe.
वृक्ष + मय, adj., f. यी, Abounding in trees.
